component.name: Lucent
component.summary: Control Razer Blade lighting, fans and power

description.p: Keyboard lighting, fan speed, power modes and the battery charge limit for Razer Blade laptops. Lucent talks to the hardware directly, so it needs no OpenRazer and no kernel module.

A small background service owns the device and costs nothing while it is idle. It restores the power mode the laptop forgets on every suspend, and dims the keyboard with the display rather than with the screen lock.
